title: Business Analyst III
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Job Description for a Business Analyst
   

  

 Utilize a deep understanding of the banking sector’s customer acquisition processes to provide examples related to Terafina’s product functionality
   

  

 Elicits requirements from the client and converts them into user stories and product requirements
   

  

 Works as a part of the project team and act as a bridge between the client and the Terafina technology team by elaborating the client requirements
   

  

 Ability to translate and understand integration requirements underlying the business requirements
   

  

 Liaises between the client and internal stakeholders to validate, analyze and document the requirements in the form of user stories
   

  

 Participates and lead discovery activities with the customer to lay down the requirements
   

  

 Participates in the functional design and solutioning
   

  

 Works closely with the QA team to create test scenarios and review the test cases
   

  

 Ability to learn the Agile methodology and related project tools
   

  

 Participates in the sprint grooming sessions and sprint reviews both internally and with the customer
   

  

 Open to travel to client site for requirements gathering and implementation activities like UAT
   

  

**Experience \& Skills Required**
 5 to 8 years of experience in the financial industry dealing with customer acquisitions and client interactions.
   

  

 Having worked in a bank / credit union or a technology service provider
   

  

 Business Banking experience is preferred but is not a prerequisite
   

  

 User experience with banking systems, for example core systems and Loan origination system like FIS, Temenos, Fiserv, Jack Henry, Lending 360 etc.
   

  

 Understand of the digital banking’s acquisition process is desirable
   

  

 Experience in implementing digital solutions would be an advantage but is not a prerequisite
   

  

 Familiar with Agile methodology would be an advantage but is not a prerequisite
   

  

 Knowledge and experience of Salesforce would be an added advantage but is not a prerequisite
   

  

 Any certifications like Certified Business Analysis Profession etc. would be desirable but is not a prerequisite
   

  

**Excellent Communication Skills – Written And Spoken – Is Required**
 Experience in customer onboarding is required
   

  

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list.
